# PromptCraft

> A free, curated library of AI prompts for teachers, students, freelancers, marketers, and developers. Copy in one click — no signup. A product of Nexura.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse and search the prompt library.
- [About](/about): What PromptCraft is and who built it.
- [Blog](/blog): Practical guides on using AI prompts for real work.

## Categories

- [Teachers](/categories/teachers): Lesson plans, rubrics, and classroom helpers.
- [Students](/categories/students): Study aids, essay helpers, and exam prep.
- [Freelancers](/categories/freelancers): Proposals, client emails, and pricing.
- [Marketing](/categories/marketing): Ad copy, social posts, and campaigns.
- [Developers](/categories/developers): Code reviews, debugging, and docs.
- [Image Upscaling](/categories/upscaling): Sharpen and upscale photos.
- [Background Removal](/categories/background-removal): Clean image cutouts.
- [Creative Images](/categories/creative-images): AI artwork and concept visuals.

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable URLs.
